title: A Quiet Holiday Week? Ha!
summary: A classic market cliche is that we can expect few fireworks during a holiday-shortened week. After last week’s plunges, the prospect of a truly placid Thanksgiving week seemed unlikely even before yesterday’s seismic events. We characterized the administration’s role in the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Nvidia’s (NVDA) CEO as an example of the “Trump Put” in action, a move specifically designed to put a floor under a falling market. So far today, that floor is holding, even if we have seen a pullback in the broad market.
